backlogged.summary: 'dependency_blocked' is documented in SPEC §7.6/AC-2 as a possible blocked_reason value, but in the actual code (lib/run.mjs:1602) a dependency-blocked feature always transitions to status 'skipped', never 'blocked' — setFeatureStatus only records blocked_reason when status === 'blocked'. So no real run can ever produce a feature with status blocked and blocked_reason 'dependency_blocked'; AC-2's test for that value only exercises a synthetic fixture. Not a contract violation (AC-2's check only requires approve to accept that reason string when present) but worth a note for a future SPEC/code alignment.
